metadata.investigation_scope: Authority, Governance, and Trust System Ecology
metadata.key_finding: Four-layer fail-closed trust system: Authority(paths/diff/env) → RBAC(subject/role/resource) → Approval(time/escalation) → Evidence(audit_trail). Production activation BLOCKED by default; requires explicit human approval OR complex auto-approval conditions.
metadata.critical_gate: AuthorityEnvelope.require_human_approval=True (default) denies ALL execution unless human_approved=True passed

component_1_authority_envelope.purpose: Policy boundary ahead of execution and PR creation. Fails closed on any violation.
component_1_authority_envelope.production_gating: Line 117-118: if require_human_approval and not human_approved then deny
component_1_authority_envelope.idempotency: SHA256 hash of identity_parts (stable on same inputs)
component_1_authority_envelope.disposition: RETAIN fail-closed; ENHANCE time-based expiry; COMPOSE with evidence_store

component_2_rbac_enforcer.purpose: Role-based access control enforcement. Zero unauthorized actions: failed checks raise PermissionDeniedError.

architecture.roles: 7 (system_admin > agent_operator > ci_operator > security_reviewer > doc_maintainer > agent_reader > guest)
architecture.resources: 8 (agents, workflows, secrets, docs, code, reports, roles, audit_logs)
architecture.actions: 8 (create, read, write/update, delete, execute, approve, assign)

trust_sources: Exhaustive permission matrix (single source of truth)
component_2_rbac_enforcer.production_gating: Line 491-492: raise_on_deny=True (default) raises PermissionDeniedError on failure
component_2_rbac_enforcer.disposition: RETAIN matrix as authoritative; ENHANCE persistence to evidence_store; COMPOSE with approval_service

component_3_approval_service.purpose: Time-gated escalation workflow with fallback auto-approval when stakeholders unavailable.
component_3_approval_service.state_machine: 7 states (pending, escalated, escalated_auto_approved, approved, rejected, cancelled, archived)

phases.phase_1: submit_request (line 182-225): create ApprovalRequest with auto-computed SLA deadline
phases.phase_2: check_and_escalate (line 227-248): escalate from L1→L2→L3 when SLA expired
phases.phase_3: check_auto_approval_conditions (line 276-296): auto-approve if 5 guards + 1 of 4 conditions met

auto_approval_conditions: Condition 1: Owner at L3, unavailable, request 24h+ old
Condition 2: Quorum lost (2+ unavailable) at Owner SLA expired
component_3_approval_service.production_gating: Line 319: destructive ops DENIED unless has_owner_emergency_pre_auth=True; auto-approval requires all 5 guards + 1 condition
component_3_approval_service.audit: decisions list + audit_log dict + audit codes (17 event types)
component_3_approval_service.tests: 20+ test methods in tests/test_governance_approval_service.py and governance/test_approval_engine.py
component_3_approval_service.disposition: RETAIN state machine and escalation; ENHANCE with idempotency deduplication; COMPOSE with evidence_store and RBAC gate on auto-approval

component_4_evidence_store.purpose: Durable JSONL audit trail with circuit-breaker pattern state. Defaults to .codex/improvement/evidence.jsonl (on-disk).

persistence.load: Line 102-117: read .jsonl line-by-line, deserialize, populate in-memory dicts

component_4_evidence_store.idempotency: event_id in _event_ids set; record_event returns False if already seen

circuit_breaker.logic: increment on regression/rollback; disable at threshold; check_stale disables if age > 90 days

component_4_evidence_store.audit: JSONL records with kind (event|outcome|...), payload containing event_id for end-to-end linking
component_4_evidence_store.persistence_gap: CircuitBreaker state only in-memory; lost on restart
component_4_evidence_store.disposition: RETAIN JSONL persistence and circuit breaker; ENHANCE CircuitBreaker state persistence; COMPOSE all layers

component_5_checkpoint_provider.purpose: Framework-aware checkpointing utilities. Standard layout: output/checkpoints/epoch-{n}/ with state.pt, meta.json, config.yaml, rng.json.
component_5_checkpoint_provider.pattern: StateDictProvider protocol (lines 186-200); structural interface for state extraction
component_5_checkpoint_provider.framework_binding: PyTorch-first; seed_registry wraps random.seed and torch.manual_seed to capture state snapshots
component_5_checkpoint_provider.narrow_reuse_observation: Checkpoint provider does NOT import Authority, RBAC, Approval, or Evidence. Framework-agnostic design.
component_5_checkpoint_provider.typed_unavailable_boundary: Checkpoint has no knowledge of governance; caller responsible for invoking authority.evaluate() before checkpoint read
component_5_checkpoint_provider.trust_model: File permissions on .codex/improvement/; seed registry preservation; caller authority check (NOT built-in)
component_5_checkpoint_provider.production_gating: CALLER RESPONSIBILITY: checkpoint provider has NO built-in gate; authority.evaluate() must be called BEFORE checkpoint access
component_5_checkpoint_provider.disposition: RETAIN framework agnosticism; ENHANCE with optional authority_context guard; COMPOSE with evidence_store

component_6_institutional_core.purpose: Portable evidence records with deliberately non-activating candidate evaluation. Implements institutional contracts via JSON Schema.

architecture.record_function: lines 54-78: create record with schema, payload, created_at, producer, evidence_refs, authority_refs, validation_state (candidate), lifecycle (Draft)
architecture.validate: lines 81+: Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema validation against contracts

component_6_institutional_core.validation_state: candidate (deliberately non-activating; no runtime execution without explicit approval)
component_6_institutional_core.trust_model: Schema validation, integrity digest, evidence_refs and authority_refs linking
component_6_institutional_core.production_gating: validation_state='candidate' means non-activating; must be explicitly promoted to Production
component_6_institutional_core.disposition: INSTITUTIONAL RESPONSIBILITY MAPPING: defines contracts and evidence schema for end-to-end auditing

narrow_reuse_pattern.observation: Checkpoint provider (component 5) demonstrates NARROW REUSE: does not depend on governance layers
narrow_reuse_pattern.risk: Typed unavailable-provider boundary: checkpoint can be accessed without authority check if caller forgets
narrow_reuse_pattern.mitigation: Add optional authority_context parameter to checkpoint methods; fail-closed if not provided

production_activation_gates.gate_2_approval: destructive ops require has_owner_emergency_pre_auth=True; auto-approval requires 5 guards + 1 of 4 conditions
production_activation_gates.gate_3_evidence: pattern_enabled() returns False if breaker.disabled=True (circuit breaker trips)
production_activation_gates.combined_effect: All three gates DENY by default unless explicitly permitted by caller + stakeholder + system conditions

idempotency_across_layers.evidence_level: event_id in _event_ids set; record_event returns False if duplicate
idempotency_across_layers.approval_level: request_id UUID auto-generated; NO deduplication on resubmit (GAP: each submit creates new request)
idempotency_across_layers.institutional_level: record() returns id=schema:digest(payload); deterministic on same payload

design_recommendations.title: Evidence Recording for All Authorization Decisions
design_recommendations.description: Every authority, rbac, and approval decision must be recorded to evidence_store.record(kind='...'). Implement via decorator or context manager.
design_recommendations.rationale: Current audit_logger and decisions lists are in-memory only; no durable trail for compliance

design_recommendations.title: Idempotency Deduplication at Approval Layer
design_recommendations.description: Extend AuthorityEnvelope.evaluate() to return idempotency_key. Use this in ApprovalRequest to deduplicate on (policy_code, requester_id, idempotency_key) triple.
design_recommendations.rationale: Current approval_service creates new request on every submit; no deduplication at submission

design_recommendations.title: Checkpoint Provider Authority Context Guard
design_recommendations.description: Add optional authority_context parameter to checkpoint save/load methods. Verify authority.evaluate() returned authorized=True before proceeding.
design_recommendations.rationale: Narrow reuse pattern creates boundary; checkpoint can be accessed without governance check if caller forgets

design_recommendations.title: Persist CircuitBreaker State to Evidence Store
design_recommendations.description: Record CircuitBreaker state changes to evidence_store as auxiliary records (kind='circuit_breaker_state'). Load on EvidenceStore.__post_init__().
design_recommendations.rationale: Current state lost on restart; no recovery

design_recommendations.title: End-to-End Integration Test
design_recommendations.description: Test chain: authority.evaluate() → rbac_enforcer.check_permission() → approval_service.submit_request() → evidence_store.record_event()
design_recommendations.rationale: No integration test exists; each layer tested in isolation

design_recommendations.title: Auto-Approval RBAC Enforcement
design_recommendations.description: In ApprovalService._apply_auto_approval, add check that SYSTEM_AUTO_APPROVAL has required RBAC permissions. Fail-closed if check fails.
design_recommendations.rationale: Auto-approval currently bypasses RBAC; security risk

institutional_invariant: No autonomous action shall execute without: (1) authorized=True from authority.evaluate(), (2) permission granted from rbac_enforcer.check_permission(), (3) approval state = APPROVED or ESCALATED_AUTO_APPROVED with 5 guards + 1 condition met, (4) evidence recorded in durable store. Default behavior DENIES at all gates.

disposition_matrix.authority_envelope: RETAIN fail-closed design, explicit reason tuples, idempotency via hash; ENHANCE with time-based expiry on idempotency_key; COMPOSE with evidence_store.record(kind='authority_decision')
disposition_matrix.rbac_enforcer: RETAIN permission matrix as single source of truth; ENHANCE with durable audit logging via evidence_store; COMPOSE with approval_service for APPROVE action gating
disposition_matrix.approval_service: RETAIN 7-state machine and escalation logic; ENHANCE with idempotency deduplication and RBAC gating on auto-approval; COMPOSE with evidence_store.record_outcome()
disposition_matrix.evidence_store: RETAIN JSONL persistence and circuit breaker pattern; ENHANCE with CircuitBreaker state persistence to .jsonl; COMPOSE integration with institutional_core for schema validation
disposition_matrix.checkpoint_provider: RETAIN framework agnosticism and protocol design; ENHANCE with optional authority_context guard; COMPOSE with evidence_store for checkpoint load audit trail
disposition_matrix.institutional_core: RETAIN schema validation and candidate state; ENHANCE integration points with authority → rbac → approval → evidence chain; ADD responsibility mapping for institutional roles
